notes: The FA's global broadcast partners page currently covers 2025-26; most international entries come from The FA's 'Where to watch' list for the 2026 Final and are the latest confirmed holders (many deals run 2024/25-2027/28). Confirmed for 2026-27: UK (TNT Sports + BBC, 2025/26-2028/29), USA (ESPN to 2027/28), Spain (Movistar Plus+), Italy (Eurosport/DAZN to 2027/28), Australia (Stan Sport). France 2026-27 not confirmed (beIN deal ran to 2025-26). UK: matches kicking off at 3pm Saturday are not broadcast live. Some FTA flags (TVP Sport, Mono 29, tabii, Zo'r TV) are inferred from broadcaster type.

broadcasters.note: TNT Sports main rights holder 2025/26-2028/29 (47 live matches per season incl. live from the First Round; every Third Round tie not kicking off at 3pm onwards). BBC sub-licence 2025/26-2028/29: 14 live matches per season free-to-air (two per round up to the quarter-finals, one semi-final, the final), plus highlights. HBO Max is the streaming home of TNT Sports in the UK. 2026/27 First Round: weekend of 7 Nov 2026; TNT/HBO Max and BBC TV/iPlayer share live rights in 2026/27 (Radio Times). 3pm Saturday kick-offs are not shown live.
ESPN deal 2024/25-2027/28: 79 matches per season (First Round to Final) plus Community Shield, streaming on ESPN+ (ESPN listed for the 2026 Final).
Movistar Plus+ holds rights for 2026-27 and 2027-28 (deal announced March 2026).
Warner Bros. Discovery (Eurosport) and DAZN co-exclusive through 2027-28, 70+ live matches per season.
Nine (Stan Sport) exclusive rights to the Premier League and Emirates FA Cup from 2025/26 (multi-season); 2026 Final on Stan.
beIN's French rights were extended only through 2025-26 (Sportcal, May 2025); 2026-27 holder not confirmed in sources found. beIN SPORTS 1 showed the 2026 Final.
